actions.reason: K6_C0002 and K6_C0003 are the closest competing pair (mean between-affinity 0.217, highest among reviewed pairs). The exact-pair boundary is weak and conflicting: native-view affinity geometry shows only weak positive separation across all four modalities (silhouettes 0.049-0.141, negative fractions 0.11-0.39), and structural diagnostics show a relatively high normalized-cut cost (0.690) with the union dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.600), which is merge-compatible. Although the current two-way assignment is represented (ARI 0.889), the high cross-boundary connectivity and single-cluster-dominated union indicate the union is more consistent with a single unit. The RNA phenotypes are directionally opposite (K6_C0002 immune-down/OXPHOS-up; K6_C0003 immune-up), but biological differences do not mechanically prohibit merge, and the structural evidence supports provisional union. This revision is provisional and returns to normal review.
